name: German Delivery Points
description: The lines above the street: who the address is care of, a flat, a floor with its side of the landing, a part of the building (Hinterhaus, Haus B, a block), and a firm's name. Original cases written for this corpus from Deutsche Post's addressing guidance and DIN 5008's layout, described in our own words; the postcodes are in GeoNames' list for Germany (CC BY 4.0).
